sources.name: SRCBronzeBilling
sources.description:
SELECT b.*
FROM bronze.billing b
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM silver.admissions a
    WHERE a.admission_id = TRY_CONVERT(INT, b.admission_id)
)
AND TRY_CONVERT(
    DECIMAL(12,2),
    NULLIF(
        LTRIM(RTRIM(
            REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(b.amount, 'USD', ''), '$', ''), ',', '')
        )),
        ''
    )
) IS NOT NULL
